title: Simple server
description: A server-side modpack designed to enhance the game while preserving the vanilla playstyle
body:
# Simple Server Modpack
A lightweight modpack that enhances server performance while keeping the vanilla gameplay (with *slight* changes).

## What this modpack adds besides performance mods

- [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons): Allows Minecraft to render much farther while maintaining performance.
- [Your Items Are Safe](https://modrinth.com/mod/your-items-are-safe): Spawns chests and an armor stand where a player dies.
- [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin): Improves the hunger HUD.
- [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat): Well, voice chat.
- [ViaVersion](https://modrinth.com/plugin/viaversion), [ViaBackwards](https://modrinth.com/plugin/viabackwards): Allow players using older or newer versions of Minecraft to join.
- [SkinRestorer](https://modrinth.com/mod/skinrestorer): Adds skin management.
- [LuckPerms](https://modrinth.com/plugin/luckperms): Doesn’t do anything without configuration, but useful if you want players to access certain commands without giving them operator.
- [Leaves Be Gone](https://modrinth.com/mod/leaves-be-gone): Speeds up leaf decay.
- [No Chat Reports](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-chat-reports): Self-explanatory.

(See under Dependencies of each version for the full mods list)
